notes.title: New Demo Available! (Version 0.0.6B)
notes.notes:
Sunken Stones - New Demo Update for GDX 2024 Alberta & Beyond!

Ahoy, Captains!

I'm thrilled to announce that the new demo for Sunken Stones is now live and ready for you to dive into at GDX 2024 Alberta & Beyond! This update brings a wave of fresh features and improvements that I can't wait for you to experience. Here's what's new:

[b]New In-Game UI[/b]
I've completely overhauled the in-game UI to provide a more immersive and intuitive experience. Navigating through your pirate adventures has never been easier or looked better!

[b]New Captain Select Screen[/b]
Choose your Captain with style! The new Captain Select Screen offers a more dynamic and engaging way to select your leader before setting sail.

[b]Crew Mate Changes & Balancing[/b]
I've made significant changes to Crew Mate stats and abilities to ensure a more balanced and strategic gameplay experience. Your feedback has been crucial in making these adjustments, and I think you'll appreciate the improvements.

[b]New Curse System[/b]
Introducing the Curse System! As you collect treasure, your crew becomes afflicted. When afflicted crew members fight, they add to the curse meter. Beware: if the curse meter is full at the end of a round, all creeps on the board will receive a buff. Manage your treasures and curses wisely!

[b]Retired Duplicate System (Temporarily)[/b]
I've temporarily retired the duplicate system to make way for new and exciting features. Fear not, this system will return shortly, revamped and better than ever!

[b]New Zones System (Zones 1 & 2)[/b]
Explore the new Zones system, starting with Zones 1 and 2. Each zone features a specific monster family, adding unique challenges and requiring different strategies to conquer.

I'm incredibly excited for you to try out these new features and can't wait to hear your feedback. Join me at GDX 2024 Alberta & Beyond, and let's set sail on this grand adventure together!

Fair winds and following seas,

The Sunken Stones Team

notes.title: Public Demo is Back (Version 0.0.5S)
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

I know it's been a minute but I'm back with an shiny new demo update.
This build includes a fair number of changes on the core gameplay in order to enhance the overall Sunken Stones experience:

[list]
[*] [b]Added More Roguelike Spice[/b]: I've shifted away from explicit team composition to delve deeper into the roguelike roots of the game. This change aims to introduce more variance and test how it impacts overall strategy and decision making.
[*] [b]Simplified Turn Orders[/b]: Turn orders have been streamlined into three distinct phases:
[list]
[*] Loot Phase: Open any chests you've gathered and on board any crew mates saved/discovered on your journey.
[*] Deploy Phase: Position your crew strategically on the board to combat Creeps.
[*] Enemy Phase: Face the challenges posed by the monster and hazard spawns.
[/list]

[*] [b]New Hazards Introduced: [/b]I've added rocks as environmental hazards. These obstacles encourage more nuanced decision-making and create interesting deployment choices, adding a new layer of depth to the gameplay.
[*] 
[*] [b]Expanded Crew Roster:[/b] The number of crew mates you can discover on your voyage has increased to 15, offering more diversity and strategic options.

[*] [b]Relationship Progression System Temporarily Removed:[/b] I've temporarily sunset the relationship progression system as I explore other potential directions for character development and interaction.
[/list]

I believe these updates will provide a fresh and engaging experience, encouraging players to experiment with new strategies and adapt to ever-changing challenges. I look forward to your feedback as you embark on your adventures in Sunken Stones!

More to come soon!
